Name: Frostbound Finale
Desc: While casting <color=#D91414>Melodic Outburst</color>, the cast timing of <color=#D91414>Concerto Orb</color> and <color=#D91414>Rhythmic Piercing</color> can be moved up. When not carrying the Glaciation Effect, the first use of <color=#D91414>Melodic Outburst</color> upon each switch-in triggers <color=#D91414>Time Lag Calculation</color>. After using <color=#D91414>Rhythmic Piercing</color>, the next use of <color=#D91414>Signature - Majestic Interlude</color> deals <color=#D91414>100%</color> increased Base DMG. This effect cannot stack and is retained when switched out. After using <color=#D91414>Signature - Note of Termination</color>, the next <color=#D91414>Basic Attack - Echoing Melody</color> gains an additional <color=#D91414>15 Signature Energy</color>. When carrying the Glaciation Effect, while Ice Spikes persist, the Glaciation DMG of <color=#D91414>Melodic Outburst and Signature - Note of Termination</color> increases by <color=#D91414>50%</color>, and the Glaciation DMG of <color=#D91414>Signature - Majestic Interlude</color> increases by <color=#D91414>100%</color>.

Name: 镜梦偕生
Desc: 释放<color=#D91414>必杀-于万象中重生</color>时，清除所有飞刃，转换成等量蓝球，且触发未冷却的超算空间；每场上场时，首次释放<color=#D91414>叠光</color>后获得<color=#D91414>7</color>点必杀能量；释放<color=#D91414>必杀-镜映新生</color>后获得<color=#D91414>15</color>点必杀能量；<color=#D91414>必杀-镜映新生</color>的额外伤害提高<color=#D91414>125%</color>，<color=#D91414>晓梦寻光</color>造成的伤害提升<color=#D91414>200%</color>，<color=#D91414>潜梦</color>状态下，每个信号球对<color=#D91414>千芒一刹</color>的基础伤害提升效果提升到<color=#D91414>40%</color>；处于<color=#D91414>渡黯身</color>状态时，<color=#D91414>必杀-镜映新生</color>的额外伤害提高<color=#D91414>50%</color>，<color=#D91414>晓梦寻光</color>黯衍伤害提升<color=#D91414>60%</color>，<color=#D91414>潜梦</color>状态下，每个信号球对<color=#D91414>千芒一刹</color>的基础伤害提升效果提升到<color=#D91414>30%</color>。
